corrected_fields.bug_semantics: The BIC's sender-stride conversion can turn a device-controlled implicit-feedback sync packet into a playback frame count above ep->maxframesize. That count is copied into the outbound URB context and historically could exceed transfer-buffer and endpoint descriptor bounds. Playback and silence OOB guards landed in January/February 2026; 7cb2a542 then fixed the remaining root cause at the common consumer by capping the count to ep->maxframesize. The July 8d7a30c commit adds the same cap earlier at the producer and is redundant on mainline.
corrected_fields.reasoning: 28acb120 is the atomic BIC and has no AI marker, so NOT_AI is unchanged. The fix fields and lifecycle evidence require correction because repository ancestry and source inspection prove that human-authored 7cb2a542 directly removed the oversized-frame path months before AI-assisted 8d7a30c.
